The EX-60D-KVM is a dual-display HDMI KVM extender designed to transmit two 1080p video signals and USB peripherals over a single category cable up to 80 meters. Using visually lossless compression, the extender allows dual HDMI displays and USB devices to operate remotely from a central computer while maintaining reliable performance and simplified installation. Ideal for dual-monitor workstations, training environments, and light commercial control applications, the EX-60D-KVM delivers efficient workstation extension using a single-cable infrastructure.

The EX-60D-KVM simultaneously transmits two independent HDMI video streams at up to 1080p60 4:4:4 over a single category cable. This capability makes the extender ideal for dual-monitor workstations, allowing users to maintain their full desktop workspace remotely without compromising performance or requiring additional infrastructure.
Designed for flexible deployment, the EX-60D-KVM extends video and USB signals over standard Cat5e/6/6a/7 cabling.

The EX-60D-KVM is a dual-display HDMI KVM extender designed to transmit two 1080p video signals and USB peripherals over a single category cable up to 80 meters. Using visually lossless compression, the extender allows dual HDMI displays and USB devices to operate remotely from a central computer while maintaining reliable performance and simplified installation. Ideal for dual-monitor workstations, training environments, and light commercial control applications, the EX-60D-KVM delivers efficient workstation extension using a single-cable infrastructure.
Integrated USB 2.0 KVM Extension for Full Workstation Control

The extender includes a USB 2.0 host connection on the transmitter and four USB device ports on the receiver, enabling remote connection of keyboards, mice, touchscreens, cameras, storage devices, and other peripherals. Supporting USB data rates up to 480 Mbps, the EX-60D-KVM ensures responsive operation of USB devices and seamless remote workstation control, making it well suited for professional computing environments and operator workstations.

The receiver unit powers the transmitter through one-way Power over Cable (PoC), allowing both units to operate from a single power adapter installed at the receiver side. This design simplifies installation, reduces the number of power supplies required in a system, and enables cleaner deployments in equipment racks, workstations, and control environments.
